jobs.description:
Summary

Apple's Hardware Program Management organization is looking for a Program Manager to lead PMIC silicon validation hardware programs end-to-end—from initial board design through factory builds, field deployment, and ongoing support for our validation engineers. This is an individual contributor role on a high-caliber Senior Program Management team whose mission is to deliver power management silicon on schedule. You will be embedded in the heartbeat of Apple's chip development process, driving the validation hardware programs that enable our advanced PMICs to go from first bring-up to production release. In this role, you will coordinate all aspects of hardware development, including requirements definition, design, implementation, and resolving complex technical issues. To be successful, you will need a strong technical background in board design, HW/SW integration, and ideally, project management experience in system board design or FPGA development. A proven track record in a dynamic engineering environment, along with exceptional multitasking and real-time crisis management skills, are essential for this position.

Description

• Coordinate development hardware requirements from multi-functional teams • Track project schedule for all development phases to ensure HW development schedules are met • Run development hardware builds, craft and manage build matrix for hardware configurations, • manage the factory teams to meet build objectives. Drive allocation requests and distribution of hardware with those multi-functional teams • Support development hardware needs for product and IC design teams • Engage with operations team to drive material delivery for builds • Drive resolution of technical issues between multi-functional teams • Convert large amounts of data into a clear story to communicate to organizations at all levels • Identify risks, develop mitigation strategies and facilitate conflict resolution • Focused issue reporting and communication of program risks and status • Technical understanding of system design and silicon validation planning

Responsibilities

Minimum Qualifications

- BS in electrical engineer or related engineering degree
- 3 year’s experience in hardware design and/or project management
- Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years experience in project or program management, preferably within a hardware, semiconductor, silicon validation, or systems engineering environment.
- Foundational understanding of hardware development and the board design lifecycle, from concept and specification through schematic review, fabrication, bring-up, and production.
- Ability to manage complex, multi-functional programs with aggressive schedules and high-stakes technical dependencies.
- Strong communication and leadership skills, able to drive alignment across engineering, operations, and leadership stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts; comfortable digging into technical details to understand blockers and drive resolution.
- Experience supporting silicon bring-up and post-silicon validation environments is highly desirable.

jobs.description:
Summary

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Dynamic, amazing people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norms here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it. Join us to help design the next groundbreaking Apple product! If you are eager to work on challenges that no one has solved yet, you will have an outstanding and phenomenal opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple customers every single day. In this outstanding role, you will be responsible for the design and development of Virtual Prototype models and platforms for Apple RF embedded systems. Are you ready to join some of the world's leading engineers and help us deliver the next generation of ground-breaking Apple products?

Description

As a member of our Design Verification team in this highly transparent role, you are our specialist in crafting Virtual Prototype models and platforms for our RF-embedded systems. These virtual prototype platforms are targeted for pre-silicon Firmware and software development and system verification before silicon availability. You are going to identify modeling requirements with all key stakeholders, including system engineering and FW/SW development teams. A strong part of your job is also to focus on model optimization in terms of performance and memory footprint. Another responsibility will also be to support the FW/SW teams across different locations during FW/SW bring-up. Your contribution to our chips will impact the way people use our devices!

Responsibilities

Minimum Qualifications

- Good expertise in C/C++ programming
- We will be counting on your expertise and years of hands-on experience in object-oriented programming concepts
- Your communication skills are excellent, and you are used to working in an environment with tight-knit collaboration with different teams, like the rest of us here at Apple. You love working in an open and multicultural environment
- Proficient English language skills are required for this position

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor or Master or higher degree in Electrical Engineering or Communication Engineering with some years of working experience, or a PhD in a relevant field of research with excellent results.
- Prior experience in SystemC programming, transaction-level modeling (TLM), and general simulator concepts is desirable
- Hands-on experience in the cellular modem and digital signal processing areas is an advantage
- Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We also take affirmative action to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.

Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management

- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards
- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time
- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required
- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations
- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability
- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity
- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed
- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions
- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region
- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised
- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities
- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)
- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact
- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling
- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation
- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment
- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels
- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plus

Group Compliance - Investigations

Allianz Group Compliance is evolving its investigations function toward a more integrated, increasingly technology- and AI-enabled operating model. We are at the beginning of that journey. In addition, the role holder will help shape how the function adopts investigative technology and AI - pragmatically, and in a responsible, human-led way. We welcome candidates from an investigations, IT-forensics or legal-tech background who combine strong investigative capability with a genuine interest in developing this area.

Review and update policies related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to ensure alignment with industry standards

Awareness

- Develop and present detailed reports and presentations on Compliance investigations and related topics to senior management
- Analyze case data and CCMT usage to identify trends, providing strategic insights and reports where required
- Prepare responses to media requests and provide input to Sustainability reports, Audits and other similar / related information requests

Integrity Committee

- Prepare and present Integrity Committee reports and minutes

- Strong expertise in remediation and mitigation measures in an international and multicultural environment
- Exceptional ability to communicate clearly and constructively with all levels, including senior management, within a multicultural organization
- Proven ability to learn, acquire and apply new knowledge and skills in digital and investigative methodologies, laws and regulations

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Team Lead for Function Controlling (f/m/d) within the SE FIN GS BC SO organisation, you will be at the forefront of acting as business partner for SE GS Solution Functions. Your role will involve driving financial performance and supporting strategic decision-making across the Solution organization of SE GS. Your primary focus will be on optimizing cost controlling processes by implementing AI and Dash solutions, ensuring effective budget planning, and providing insightful analysis of forecasts and actuals. You will lead a global team, coaching and developing team members to achieve their full potential.
Each day, your leadership will strengthen financial performance and enhance accountability across all functions of Solution business.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the financial performance management of cost centres by preparing, consolidating, and analysing forecasts, budgets, and monthly closings
* Act as a business partner by conducting reasonable analyses of key financial drivers for cost centres, delivering clear financial reports that include deviation analyses and actionable performance insights
* Implement and oversee standardized processes and automation initiatives, leverage AI where applicable to streamline operations.
* Develop and implement dashboards that provide real-time insights into cost centre performance and manpower utilization
* Collaborate with various functions to address complex setup topics, accounting questions, and reporting issues, ensuring reliable financial steering and alignment with organizational goals

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
* Extensive experience in financial controlling, FP&A, budgeting, and corporate finance within a complex business environment
* Proven leadership capabilities in developing and managing teams of experienced finance professionals
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business decisions
* Excellent knowledge of SAP applications, financial reporting, internal controls, and process improvement within a global matrix organization
* Fluent English communication skills; German is beneficial for collaboration within the local business environment 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

To support Economics of Technologies in Agriculture in the Technology Assessment Department we are seeking, at the earliest possible date a

Doctoral researcher (m/f/d) (75 %)

for the research area

„Economic analysis of innovative fenland use“

The economic analysis includes various lines of utilization of biomass from wet fenland sites and analysis of greenhouse gas abatement potentials resulting from the change in land use. Cost analysis includes approaches and cost estimates for planning, permission, management, and harvest of mixed vegetation, storage and transportation, and processing in innovative biomass utilization pathways. Labor times, costs, and potential savings from autonomous harvesting vehicles, among others, are identified. Reference uses and innovative business models are also considered to determine the economic viability of specific processes.

The aim of the project is to create a network of model and demonstration projects for the use of rewetted fens with representative fen areas, biomass utilization pathways and relevant actors in Brandenburg. Partners are in addition to ATB the Brandenburg State Office for the Environment (LfU), the University for Sustainable Development Eberswalde (HNEE), the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF) and the Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences (GFZ). The WetNetBB network is part of a network of model and demonstration projects (PaludiNet) coordinated by the Thünen Institute (TI) and Greifswald Moor Centrum (GMC) as PaludiCenter. The position is assigned to the Technology Assessment Department at the ATB, and close cooperation with the Systems Process Engineering Department is intended. 

Yourtasks

- Development of models for calculating the economic potential of different utilization systems on wet fenlands
- Recording and analysis of the labour time requirements of novel forms of use of wet fenlands
- Quantitative and qualitative evaluation of scientific results
- Development of scenario-based calculations of the costs of agricultural use through paludiculture on lowland bog sites
- Presentation of project results at scientific conferences and stakeholder meetings
- Writing of scientific publications and project reports

Your qualifications

- Very good university degree in agricultural economics or related subjects (Diploma or Master of Science)
- Knowledge and experience in economic analysis of agricultural systems
- Knowledge in statistical data analysis
- Strong interest in interdisciplinary collaboration
- Very good knowledge of written and spoken English
- Very good knowledge of German for communication with stakeholders and farmers
- Ability to work in a team and willingness to cooperate, reliability, flexibility, personal commitment and independent working skills
- EU driving license class B desirable

We offer

- Encouragement and support for PhD candidates in pursuing their doctoral studies in collaboration with partner universities
- An attractive, research-intensive, and interdisciplinary working environment
- A varied position at the interface of science and practice
- Excellent infrastructure for scientific work
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Participation in the VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The part-time position (30 hours/week) is initially limited to 4 years. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade E 13.

For further information, please contact Dr. Andreas Meyer-Aurich (phone +49 331 5699-222) and visit our website at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

jobs.description:
At a time when global technological developments and healthcare regulations are occurring and changing at an unprecedented rate, the success of large, complex global organizations that engage deeply in this space requires a legal/business leader who is deeply steeped in the levers, both public and private that impact this industry. To remain competitive in this rapidly changing landscape, organizations require a skilled legal counsel eager to build deeper expertise in healthcare and life sciences regulation, particularly at the EU level.

In this context, we are seeking a German-qualified lawyer with expertise in software as a medical device and healthcare regulatory law, who will support the senior legal team in managing legal and regulatory requirements in the region, especially Germany and the European Union.

About the business

Oracle's Healthcare and Life Sciences business provides industry-specific software and solutions to healthcare providers, payers, pharmaceutical, and medical device companies, and clinical research organizations. It offers a range of products and services, including cloud-based healthcare platforms, data analytics, electronic health records (EHR), and patient engagement systems. The business aims to help organizations improve patient outcomes, lower costs, and accelerate innovation. By leveraging Oracle's technology and expertise, healthcare and life science organizations can streamline their operations, gain insights from data, and make more informed decisions. Oracle also enables secure and compliant handling of sensitive healthcare data, helping organizations meet regulatory requirements and protect patient privacy. With a focus on digital transformation, Oracle's Healthcare and Life Sciences business empowers the industry to embrace modern technologies and improve overall healthcare delivery.

What you’ll do

As Legal Counsel, EMEA Health and Life Sciences, you will support the senior legal team in driving Oracle’s health and life sciences regulatory strategy and implementation in the region, working closely with senior lawyers in the team, the health and medical device regulatory teams and the health and compliance teams, along with product, sales, and consulting teams to provide succinct legal advise on EU and local regulations related to healthcare tech and life sciences products, emphasizing patient safety as a priority.

Specific Responsibilities include:

- Support in developing and implementing the health and life sciences legal regulatory strategy in the region, with a particular focus on Germany and the European Union, support the advise, and education of Oracle Life Sciences and Health staff on legal and regulatory requirements and policy initiatives.
- Support the advise and provide legal drafting, including preparation of legal memoranda and position papers, on legal regulatory issues impacting our customers’ use of Oracle products with a focus on electronic health records technologies, artificial intelligence and machine learning, software as a medical device, and life sciences clinical research.
- Monitor, research, and summarize relevant legal and regulatory developments, especially at the EU and German national level, and assess their impact on Oracle Health and Life Sciences products and services. Provide legal opinions on regulatory questions as required.
- Draft and review legal correspondence with regulatory authorities and courts, and represent Oracle in administrative proceedings as needed, under supervision of senior counsel.
- Assist in the preparation and submission of legal filings with regulatory bodies and agencies in Germany and the European Union to support Oracle’s health policy initiatives.
- Support the implementation of regulatory strategies to help ensure compliance with software as a medical device regulations within Germany and the EU.
- Contribute to projects promoting patient safety and regulatory compliance with guidance from senior legal and product teams.
- Support the review and implementation of regulatory strategies for evolving AI/ML regulations relevant to health and life sciences within the EU, as needed. Additional Responsibilities
- Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, with a focus on legal and regulatory requirements under EU and German law.
- Prepare legal research, detailed memoranda, legal opinions, and comprehensive case files for internal and external stakeholders.
- Support documentation and compliance initiatives related to GDPR, EHDS, and other EU health data regulations.
- Collaborate with internal teams, including product development and compliance, to advise on legal and regulatory implications and progress regulatory program goals.

What you’ll bring

- We are seeking a German qualified lawyer (First and Second State Bar Exam (Volljurist)) with 1–3 years of legal experience in healthcare or life sciences, with a demonstrated background in a law firm, the legal department of a company and/or a regulatory authority.

- Proven experience and interest in Medical Devices / Medical Devices Software and AI Regulation.
- Professional demeanor, confidence, and innovation with the ability to effectively communicate with colleagues and internal stakeholders.
- Excellent writing, analysis, negotiation, and research skills.
- Project management and interpersonal skills.
- Business orientation and ability to balance legal considerations with commercial priorities.
- Ability to perform in a fast-paced and continually evolving business environment.
- Fluency in German and English is required; knowledge of additional EU languages is a plus.

Competencies

Collaboration You actively contribute to team efforts, value different perspectives, and work effectively with colleagues across departments to help achieve shared objectives.
- Communicating for impact: You communicate clearly and professionally, ensuring transparency and understanding in your work and interactions, and effectively support the organization’s goals.
Competitive edge: You stay informed about industry trends and client needs, identifying opportunities to add value and proposing fresh solutions within your area of responsibility.

Mastering complexity: You approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset, seeking guidance when needed, and contribute to practical solutions for complex issues in your daily tasks. jobs.occupation: The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as Junior Researcher / Pr (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as

Junior Researcher / PreDoc (Kiel or Berlin)

We are looking for up to two highly motivated Junior Researchers / PreDocs to join our dynamic research team at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy. The positions are almost full-time (75-90 percent). One position should be based in Kiel and another one optional in Kiel or in our Research Hub in Berlin. Both positions are linked to the research group by Prof. Christoph Trebesch and his ERC project on Great Power Finance.

The two positions have the following focus, respectively:

1. Digital chokepoints: geopolitical risk and telecom networks
2. International capital flows: great powers and cross-border investments across 200 years 

Your Role 

Your main role will be to contribute to cutting-edge research on one or two of the projects. The work will involve extensive data collection and rigorous empirical analysis using historical and contemporary sources. A particular focus of these roles will be archival research and the construction of novel datasets from historical records and documents related to telecommunications, computer science, financial assets and international capital flows.

As part of Christoph Trebesch’s research group, you will work closely with senior researchers on high-impact projects in macroeconomics, economic history, and political economy. The positions offer an excellent opportunity to gain advanced research experience, develop strong empirical skills, and contribute to internationally visible academic work.

Your Profile 

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

- ·         Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in economics (completed or close to completion) with very good grades.
- ·         Strong quantitative and empirical skills and experience, particularly:
- For position (1): experience with data on telecommunication and computer science
- For position (2): experience with data on financial assets and/or international capital flows, ideally also historical financial data
- ·         Experience with advanced AI tools and statistical software such as Stata, R, and/or Python.
- ·         Interest in historical research and archival work.
- ·         Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment. 
- ·         Excellent analytical and organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to high-quality research.
- The working language is English; excellent English skills are therefore required. Some knowledge of German would be useful, but is not important.

We are offering 

The planned contract period is 10 months (starting in the fall of 2026). The salary will be based on the German public sector pay scale at grade EG 12 or 13 TV L. The position is part-time between 75-90%.

The Kiel Institute for the World Economy values diversity. We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age or sexual orientation. The Kiel Institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/equal-opportunity/) . We promote the professional opportunities of women and strongly encourage them to apply. Women with equivalent qualifications, competence and expertise will be given preference. We are committed to employing persons with recognized disabilities and will therefore give them preference over persons without disabilities if they are equally qualified. 

In order to be eligible for this position you have to hold EU citizenship or need to be able to provide a work permit that is valid throughout the time of your contract.

Please submit your application online (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/job-vacancies/junior-researcher-/-predoc-kiel-or-berlin/) using ID-No. “PreDoc_2026”. Please include (i) a letter of interest, (ii) your CV, (iii) one or two work samples (e.g. Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis), (iv) university transcripts, as well as (if applicable) (v) proofs of relevant work experience. Ideally submit just one PDF, including “PreDoc” and your family name as file name. The deadline for applications is September 7, 2026 Application photos should not be included. 

For additional information, please contact Prof. Christoph Trebesch (christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de (https://mailto:christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de) ).

Benefits

jobs.description:
Summary

At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that revolutionizes entire industries. We invite you to join our dynamic group, for the unique and rewarding opportunity to contribute to upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple’s customers every day. Are you interested in doing work that challenges you, expands your thinking, provides innovative solutions for future problems while driving your growth as recognized technical leader in the cellular industry? Apple's RF Transmitter Systems Engineering team is looking for a passionate, talented individual who is eager to break technical boundaries and to change the way of doing things. Our elite team is shaping the mobile market with disruptive RF innovations while taking full responsibility for execution and commitments to schedule and quality. Join our team of leading experts in cellular RF industry and deliver differentiating transmit architectures and solutions for Apple’s wireless products that create amazing value for our customers!

Description

In this role, you will be part of an industry-leading RF Transmitter Systems Engineering team. You will work closely with other architecture- and systems engineering teams, RF design teams and SW teams to assess, specify and drive transmitter concepts with focus on leading-edge performance and uncompromised quality as baseline for differentiating products.

Responsibilities

- Your daily work includes the following tasks: 
- Translate system-level and performance requirements into requirements for the TX line-up and TX features, including RF algorithm specifications for RFICs and system firmware.
- Understand and specify RF algorithms (e.g. power control, calibration) and define the RF control infrastructure, including compute resources, interfaces, memory and timing constraints.
- Research, design, and prototype machine learning models—including neural networks and reinforcement learning—for RF transmitter applications such as power control, calibration, and digital pre-distortion.
- Develop and maintain simulation environments in Python or MATLAB to model RF systems and test AI algorithms.
- Analyze simulation data to evaluate model performance, identify trade-offs, and propose improvements.

Minimum Qualifications

- Proven years of relevant experience in RF, including cellular transmit architectures, or PhD degree with previous work on cellular topics.
- Knowledge of cellular radio/3GPP standards (GSM, UMTS, LTE, LTE-A, 5G NR), including RF aspects as well as system use cases and TX waveforms.
- Familiarity with RF systems and transceiver architecture, including lineup design and component-level trade-offs (e.g. gain, linearity, noise, power, thermal). 
- Solid theoretical grounding and hands-on experience with classical machine learning techniques (e.g., clustering, dimensionality reduction) applied to regression and classification problems.
- Solid theoretical understanding and hands-on experience with neural networks for regression and classification problems. 
- Practical experience across supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to collaborate and communicate across multicultural, global teams.
- BSEE or MSEE.
- Proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

- Initial expertise in transmitter system-level concepts and control procedures like power control, digital predistortion, envelope tracking.
- Background in digital signal processing.
- Understanding of SoC integration constraints and multi-chip RF architectures.
- Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Agrartechnik und Bioökonomie e.V.
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

As part of the HORIZON project ‘Towards scalable monitoring, reporting, verification and mitigation of non-CO2 greenhouse gas and ammonia emissions from land-based agricultural systems (MARVELA)’, we are looking, subject to funding approval, for a

Scientist (PostDoc) (m/f/d) (100 %)

for the task area 

Development and validation of IoT-based sensor systems for environmental monitoring

Within the MARVELA project, innovative, cost-effective and user-friendly measurement systems for the continuous monitoring of greenhouse gases, ammonia and relevant environmental parameters at farm level will be developed, optimized and validated. At ATB, the work focuses on the further development of modular IoT-based sensor systems, the integration of sensors, embedded electronics and communication interfaces, and their application in livestock buildings and manure-management systems. The developed systems will be tested under laboratory and practical farm conditions and validated against state-of-the-art reference measurement methods.

Your tasks

Your main responsibility will be the development, implementation and scientific validation of electronic measurement systems for agricultural emission monitoring. This includes in particular:

- Further development and optimization of modular IoT-based sensor systems for environmental and emission monitoring
- Integration of sensors, embedded electronics, data loggers, power supplies and communication interfaces into robust measurement systems
- Programming and configuration of microcontrollers, device interfaces and automated data-acquisition systems
- Planning and conducting laboratory tests, calibrations and measurement campaigns in livestock and manure-management systems
- Validation of low-cost and mid-cost sensors against state-of-the-art reference measurement instruments
- Development and implementation of quality-assurance procedures, measurement protocols and technical documentation
- Processing, quality control, statistical analysis and interpretation of measurement data
- Coordination of technical activities with project partners and preparation of scientific publications, reports and presentations

Your qualifications

- Successfully completed doctorate in electrical engineering, mechatronics, technical informatics, embedded systems, measurement and sensor technology, physical engineering or a comparable discipline
- Proven experience in scientific project management
- Proven experience in the development, integration and operation of measurement and sensor systems
- Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers and hardware-related programming
- Knowledge of common device interfaces and communication protocols, such as I²C, SPI, UART, RS-485, Modbus, Ethernet or LoRaWAN
- Experience in sensor calibration, measurement-system validation, quality assurance and systematic troubleshooting
- Strong programming and data-analysis skills, preferably in Python, R, MATLAB, C or C++
- Very good English skills, an independent and solution-oriented working style, teamwork, willingness to conduct field measurements
- Desirable: Good command of German, EU driving licence class B

We offer

- An attractive, interdisciplinary and international working environment with a highly motivated team
- An exciting position in a cutting-edge field of environmental monitoring and sensor technology
- Excellent infrastructure with state-of-the-art laboratory and measurement technology
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Financial contribution to VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The full-time position (40 hours/week) is initially limited to 3 years. Part-time employment is also possible if desired. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade 13. The preferred starting date is in Q1 2027.

For more information, please contact Dr.-Ing. David Janke (Tel.: +49 331-5699 513) and on the Internet at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

About ForEveryone ForEveryone is a non-profit social enterprise in Berlin. We bring people from different backgrounds together, among other things through our community café at Boxhagener Platz and through workshops, events and activities for an international Berlin audience. We are growing, and we are currently reshaping our whole range of activities.

What this role is about We are looking for someone to oversee, develop and be present across our whole range of activities – from workshops to events at our community café at Boxhagener Platz (jam sessions, music nights, exhibitions and more). The clear goal: turning individual activities into recurring small communities with their own memberships. Instead of activities we have to market and fill again every time, we want formats people come back to regularly – a knitting club, a sports format, creative combinations, a recurring music night. You drive this: you sense what the community wants, develop formats to match, test them, run them yourself, recruit and support the volunteers who help carry them, and make sure the good ones actually happen and grow.

What you'll do

- Oversee and support the offering. You keep an eye on all running activities – workshops and café events alike – are regularly present on site, and make sure everything runs smoothly, including the operational side in our booking tool (cancellations, refunds, correct details) – a small but important part of the week.
- Develop and test formats and events. You sense what activities the community wants, identify new workshop, event and mini-formats, research trends and seasonal demand (what are others offering, what works in a summer lull?), and honestly test which formats land well enough to sustain, and which don't.
- Build mini-communities with memberships. You develop formats with recurring communities in mind – ones people belong to as members – and take them from first idea to an established, recurring offering.
- Run activities and enable volunteers. You run workshops and events yourself on a regular basis, at a good standard – weekly, sometimes with support from volunteers. You recruit volunteers (including from among participants), onboard them, give them direct feedback, and support them until they can carry a format.
- Guide formats through their phases. For new formats: experiment and learn from feedback. For established ones: set up clean processes, with reliability and scaling in mind.

What you bring

- Experience running workshops, events, groups or community formats, at a quality others can build on.
- A feel for people and communities, and enjoyment in recruiting and supporting volunteers.
- Conceptual strength: you can develop formats, test them, and judge honestly what works.
- Self-direction and ownership – you drive your area like a genuine project lead.
- Fixed on-site times: at least 3–4 evenings per week (around 2–3 hours each, within the 5–10 pm window) plus 1 day at the weekend (Saturday or Sunday, daytime or evening). These are your core working hours. The rest of your time you can arrange flexibly from the office. This on-site presence comes with a lot of creative freedom, but it is also a clear expectation.
- Comfortable with digital tools; German and English are a strong plus for our multilingual community.

What to expect from us

- A role with real room to shape things: you are building something that doesn't exist yet.
- A small, committed team and real closeness to a lively, international community.
- We set the strategic and financial direction (e.g. the membership model) as managing directors; you develop and decide on the formats independently, with our final sign-off.

Terms

- Start: September/October 2026 or by arrangement
- Pay: €2,400–2,800 gross/month (at 36 hrs)

Summary

Would you like to be part of Apple’s fast-growing RF wireless design team in Munich? We are responsible for all aspects of wireless silicon development with a particular emphasis on highly integrated, power efficient designs and advanced semiconductor technologies that enable an outstanding user experience. IC design engineers work on circuit and system solutions for sophisticated wireless chips. This is a highly visible role in a fast growing silicon design group where you'll have the opportunity to make a critical impact on getting innovative consumer products to a global customer base quickly!

Description

As a RF Design Engineer at Apple, you will use your vast background in circuit design and provide PLL design solutions for wireless chips. You will collaborate with platform architects, system group, and digital design group to define the requirements for a PLL lineup based on the product requirements. You will also work with the Apple technology team and silicon foundries on process evaluation/selection for the target device. Design tasks include various analog biasing blocks, oscillators, frequency dividers and local oscillator chains. You will work with system engineering, layout, and chip integration teams to integrate the IP’s and verify the top-level functionality and performance. You also will work with RF test engineers to bring up, characterize and optimize new silicon.

Minimum Qualifications

- Profound experience in RF circuit design techniques.
- Experience with Cadence design tools.
- EM modelling and simulation skills.
- MSEE /PhD or equivalent is required.
- Proficiency in English is required.

Preferred Qualifications

- A proven track record in RF, and analog integrated circuit design, with experience in wireless PLL circuit architectures in CMOS technologies.
- Deep understanding in PLL system specifications and the ability to work with system architects to translate system requirements into circuit requirements at IC block level. 
- Knowledge in fundamental RF theories and concepts, such as innovative PLL concepts and their trade-offs in key performance parameters (KPI’s), area and power efficiency.
- The ability to optimize the overall PLL system including EVM, blocker requirements and crosstalk mitigations.
- Deep technical knowledge in analysis, design, and implementation of RF wireless low-noise, broadband and power efficient PLLs, as well as frequency converting blocks.
- Extensive experience in simulation of RF analog key building blocks, such as oscillators, frequency dividers, phase detectors and local oscillator signal distribution chains
- Solid experience in optimization of RF circuit design impairments by means of highly sophisticated methods of trimming and calibration 
- Experience in RF cross talk analysis, understanding the critical RF cross talk building laws and the according aggressor and victim analysis, translation of RF system KPI's into IC block level isolation requirements 
- Understanding of RF device modelling, insights into packaging effects, integrated coils, supply isolations, high frequency ESD structures, and circuit layout for optimum performance.

As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.

Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves
* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning
* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively
* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods
* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives
* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholders

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. jobs.description:
What to Expect

We are scaling our Virtual Power Plant (VPP) operations into the German energy market and are looking for a hands-on VPP Operations Specialist – Germany to support that growth from day one. We need someone who can roll up their sleeves, own exceptions end-to-end, and bring deep practical knowledge of how the German energy market operates at a process and regulatory level.You will be embedded in our Operations team, working closely with our flexibility, settlements, and support functions across the globe. A key part of your role will be upskilling our support staff on German market workflows, participant journeys, and exception handling – ensuring the whole team can operate confidently as we grow our German footprint.

What You’ll Do

Market Operations

- Apply working knowledge of the German energy regulatory landscape (BNetzA, BDEW) to day-to-day operational tasks.
- Manage and resolve data flow exceptions relating to MaKo/EDIFACT messaging, GPKE, and WiM processes, and MSB/VNB interactions.
- Support the accurate management of MaLo and MeLo data, ensuring data integrity across systems.
- Work within the MsbG metering framework and support smart meter rollout processes relevant to VPP-connected assets.
- Demonstrate solid understanding of MaBis processes.
- Monitor Bilanzkreis and settlement obligations relevant to our flexible asset portfolio in Germany.Flexibility Participant & Exception Management
- Act as the primary handler for escalated exceptions arising from the German flexibility participant journey – from asset registration through to settlement and payment queries.
- Own complex cases end-to-end, coordinating across internal teams (settlements, tech, finance) to reach resolution.
- Identify recurring issues and escalate systemic root causes with clear data and recommended fixes.
- Support onboarding of new German flexibility participants and asset owners, ensuring a smooth and compliant process.Training & Knowledge Transfer
- Design and deliver structured training sessions for UK-based support staff covering German market processes, regulatory obligations, and participant workflows.
- Build and maintain clear, practical playbooks, process guides, and FAQs for use by the wider support team.
- Conduct regular knowledge gap assessments and adjust training content accordingly.
- Review training effectiveness and iterate based on team performance and feedback.Process Improvement & Efficiency
- Actively identify manual or repetitive tasks and find ways to reduce effort through process redesign or tooling.
- Maintain up-to-date process documentation in a clear, accessible format.
- Flag regulatory or process changes in the German market that may impact operations and recommend responses.

What You’ll Bring

Candidates should be able to demonstrate practical working knowledge across most of the following:

- BNetzA regulatory framework and BDEW market rules
- MaKo communication standards and EDIFACT message types
- GPKE (supplier switching) and WiM (metering point management) processes
- MsbG obligations and the role of the Messstellenbetreiber (MSB)
- MaLo (market location) and MeLo (metering location) data structures
- Bilanzkreis management and balancing group settlement
- German electricity billing structures including Netzentgelte and Grundversorgung vs. competitive supply frameworks
- Direktvermarktung framework
- MaBis processes for balancing group settlement reconciliation
- FCR/aFRR/mFFR prequalification and flexibility market participation rules (desirable)Essential
- Fluent in English and German (written and spoken), with experience communicating with German counterparts and producing documentation in both languages
- Demonstrable hands-on experience working within the German energy market at an operational level (a minimum of 3 years)
- Proven ability to manage exceptions and complex operational cases end-to-end
- Experience designing and delivering training or knowledge transfer programmes
- Strong analytical mindset with a practical, solutions-first approach
- Comfortable working autonomously and picking up tasks without needing close directionDesirable
- Experience with MaKo-compliant systems or EDIFACT messaging tools
- Knowledge of MSB obligations and smart meter rollout processes in Germany
- Experience working across multiple European energy markets
- Experience in a scale-up or market entry environment

Instrumentation, Controls & Power Systems

- Prepare technical specifications and tender documentation.

You thrive in multidisciplinary teams, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and balance attention to detail with system-level thinking. - Interest in microprocessor-based systems and edge controllers.
- Experience working with suppliers, contractors, or external engineering partners.
- Strong communication skills in English; German language skills are welcome but not required.

What You'll Find at GlassPoint

Tesla Energy is
deploying the world’s largest fleet of battery energy storage systems (BESS)
from residential Powerwall to grid-scale Megapack, across dozens of markets
worldwide. Regulatory safety certification is the gate between engineering and
the market.

As a Regulatory Safety
Engineer you will be the in-house expert on product safety standards and
market-entry regulations for BESS and supporting power electronics. You will
translate complex normative requirements such as IEC, UL, CSA, EN, and beyond
into engineering design specifications, then drive products through
certification from first design review to certificate issue. You will work
alongside hardware, power electronics, firmware, and systems engineers, making
compliance a design and integral part of the process.

- Research and maintain a living map of market-entry requirements for BESS and ancillary equipment across North America, Europe, Australia, and emerging markets; interpret and apply applicable codes, regulations, and directives. 
- Horizon-scan for new and evolving standards affecting BESS products and communicate regulatory risk to engineering and programme leadership. 
- Develop Compliance Product Design Requirements (CPDRs) translating normative requirements into unambiguous engineering specifications, covering product-specific standards (IEC 62619, IEC 62933 series, IEC 62109/62477 series, UL 9540/9540A, UL 1741, UL 1973), and fundamental safety principles such as IEC 60664 series insulation coordination, IEC 60990 touch current, and IEC 60529 IP ratings. 
- Lead design reviews to identify compliance gaps and safety risks early; propose and track engineering solutions to closure. 
- Own CE marking end-to-end: conformity assessment route selection, technical file compilation, Declaration of Conformity (DoC) drafting, and Notified Body or competent authority liaison. 
- Define and manage certification strategies across global schemes such as UL/cUL (NRTL), CB Scheme (IECEE), CE marking, AS/NZS, and others as markets are entered, and author test plans and lead testing in-house and at accredited third-party laboratories. 
- Debug certification failures, root-cause anomalies, and propose design and/or test-method solutions; review test reports and manage certificate lifecycles, surveillance audits, and re-certification triggered by engineering changes. 
- Act as the regulatory safety SME for cross-functional engineering teams; support field compliance escalations and post-market surveillance; build internal knowledge bases and mentor junior engineers on regulatory processes and certification strategy. 

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Electrical / Electronic Engineering or equivalent; 5+ years in product safety certification for power electronics or energy storage products. 
- Proven CE marking expertise: technical file construction, DoC preparation, and Notified Body liaison; hands-on BESS and power electronics certification experience across IEC and UL standards (IEC 62619, 62933, 62109/62477, UL 9540, UL 1741, UL 1973). 
- Strong ability to interpret complex normative text, resolve ambiguities with laboratories and regulators, and translate requirements into testable engineering specifications.

PhD-Student (m/f/d)

Join an interdisciplinary research project at the interface of neurobiology, RNA biology, and bioinformatics. The aim of this PhD project is to decipher the regulatory mechanisms underlying RNA dysregulation in response to environmental and viral stressors. Using innovative brain organoid models, you will apply computational and experimental approaches to investigate the effects of microplastics and/or HSV-1 infections on RNA regulation in models of Alzheimer's disease and healthy controls. The insights gained are expected to contribute to a better understanding of the development and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

As part of this PhD project, you will employ state-of-the-art sequencing and analytical techniques to investigate how environmental factors and viral infections influence RNA regulation in the human brain. Particular emphasis will be placed on understanding the molecular mechanisms that may contribute to the onset and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

- Analyze alterations in RNA regulation in the human brain using single-cell transcriptomics and long-read RNA sequencing.
- Investigate key RNA regulatory processes, including alternative splicing, RNA isoform usage, polyadenylation dynamics, and transposable element activity.
- Explore the effects of HSV-1 infections and genetic risk factors on RNA isoform diversity and regulation.
- Integrate and analyze transcriptomic and epitranscriptomic datasets to identify disease-relevant molecular mechanisms.
- Compare data from human brain organoid models with datasets from Alzheimer’s disease patients to assess the disease relevance of the models.
- Develop and apply bioinformatics approaches for the analysis of complex multi-omics datasets.
- Present and discuss research findings within the team and at national and international scientific conferences.
- Contribute to scientific publications in leading international peer-reviewed journals.
- Opportunity to expand the project to additional molecular layers, including proteomics, metabolomics, and lipidomics.
- Completed Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Neuroscience, or a related field.
- Strong enthusiasm for RNA biology and research into neurodegenerative diseases.
- Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Analysis of RNA sequencing and other omics datasets (bulk, single-cell, and/or long-read data)
- Programming and data analysis, particularly using Python and/or R
- Ability to work independently in a structured and goal-oriented manner.
- Strong teamwork and communication skills, with enthusiasm for collaborating in interdisciplinary and international research environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English skills.

Desirable Qualifications

- Experience in the analysis of RNA isoforms, alternative splicing, or epitranscriptomic datasets.
- Knowledge of multi-omics data integration and analysis.
- Interest in organoid models and translational biomedical research.
- Practical experience in experimental molecular biology, such as cell culture, organoid technologies, or RNA sequencing.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Finance Business Analyst (f/m/d) for our Distribution Transformers business, covering six manufacturing locations worldwide, you will play a key role in supporting strategic Sales, T&O and DS initiatives while ensuring financial transparency and performance.
Working closely with plant controllers, performance analysts and cross-functional stakeholders, you will translate financial insights into business actions, harmonize reporting standards and contribute to productivity and cost optimization programs. Your work will help ensure that investments in innovation, digitalization and operational efficiency deliver measurable value and strengthen our position as a leading provider of reliable and sustainable transformer solutions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Drive financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and operational excellence initiatives (e.g. productivity and cost-out programs) for Sales, T&O and DS across six global manufacturing sites.
* Consolidate, monitor and report key financial KPIs and expenditures while ensuring compliance with internal standards and external requirements.
* Prepare and analyse financial reports (e.g. Order Intake, Target Costing, Pricing and Margin Slippage) to support data-driven management decisions.
* Evaluate business cases for portfolio development, technology investments, process automation and resource optimization initiatives.
* Partner closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Management and DS teams to assess financial requirements and support strategic initiatives.
* Coordinate and guide plant controllers and performance analysts, driving standardized reporting, benchmarking and transparency across all sites.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field.
* Proven experience in financial controlling, ideally within manufacturing, industrial or energy-related environments.
* Expertise in financial planning, forecasting and performance analysis, combined with a solid understanding of operational excellence principles.
* Experience working in a multi-site and international business environment with diverse stakeholders.
* Proficiency in ERP systems (preferably SAP) and advanced analytical and financial modelling skills.
* Excellent communication skills, fluency in English, German is an advantage and willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10–20%). 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is 
the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

As part of the HR Operations organization, the HR Operations Specialist will deliver first line support and day-to-day direction to the complete HR team in EMEA or other stakeholders.  The HR Operations Specialist is the first point of contact for our employees and they will respond to employee inquiries, by providing support, advice, problem solving, identifying solutions and escalates as needed. jobs.description:
What to Expect

As a Closures Sealing Engineer, you will work with some of the industry’s brightest minds and take engineering ownership of complete static and dynamic sealing systems as well as Daylight Opening trims for Tesla vehicles. Your work will focus on static and dynamic seals for current vehicle programs, with an emphasis on quality improvement, cost reduction, and manufacturing enhancements. Additionally, you will be responsible for the engineering and design of static and dynamic seals and DLO trims for future vehicle programs.   Your ownership of seals will include initiating and overseeing both virtual (CAE) and physical testing and analysis to validate new designs from concept to production. This role provides a great opportunity to interface with all aspects of vehicle development. You will work closely with the body, closures, electrical/firmware, exterior, and interior teams, as well as with manufacturing engineering, to establish world-class seal and trim designs along with world-class assembly processes.  

What You’ll Do

- Serve as a member of the Vehicle Engineering Team, supporting closure system static and dynamic sealing and DLO trim development for Tesla vehicles  
- Fully specify elastomeric seal designs through the creation of specification drawings 
- Initiate seal CAE studies, interpret results, and iterate until geometry and materials meet design targets 
- Select appropriate materials for elastomeric static and dynamic seals and DLO trims 
- Understand manufacturing processes used to produce elastomeric seals, TP & metallic trims, and assembly processes 
- Achieve innovation-driven closure sealing & trims system targets for appearance, function, quality, cost, and weight

- Manage and collaborate with key suppliers (both internal and external) to support overall vehicle development milestones and prototype/ production build events 

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience, with evidence of exceptional ability 
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in the design and engineering of static/dynamic seals and exterior trims 
- Strong understanding of GD&T 
- Ability to interpret FEA results and integrate recommendations into product designs 
- Experience designing new and improved seals and trim components using design software 
- Proficiency in CAD software V5/3DX for designing 2D sections and 3D geometry of seals. Experience designing complex seal molds is a plus

expertise in a wide range of topics in order to create an impact. We offer an

humble and open – define how we work together as a department.

the central governance department for the internal control system at Siemens.

state-of-the-art internal control methodology and the support of our global
internal control community in applying it. In close collaboration with

harmonized control requirements (the ‘Policy and Control Masterbook’) as well

internal control process.

ensuring robust Internal Controls across the enterprise, especially over

others to give their best. You are comfortable challenging established
approaches and driving change where it creates value. Be bold and apply now to become a part of our CF Assurance Internal Control team in

Mode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time & Part-time
