jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿

Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will lead and execute clinical Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) modeling projects within multidisciplinary systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and drug development teams, driving model-informed decision making across development programs.
- Additionally, you will develop, qualify, apply, and communicate fit-for-purpose QSP models that integrate non-clinical, translational, biomarker, and clinical data to address critical scientific and development questions.
- You will also translate biological and pharmacological knowledge into quantitative model structures, assumptions, and simulations, generating actionable insights while clearly communicating model limitations, uncertainties, and their potential impact.
- Furthermore, you will define and drive QSP modeling strategies aligned with project objectives, delivering scientifically robust analyses and interpretations to support clinical development decisions.
- You will provide independent advice on complex mechanistic modeling challenges and represent QSP expertise in cross-functional scientific, technical, and strategic discussions.
- Beyond this, you will provide scientific leadership and guidance throughout model development, qualification, application, and communication activities while fostering collaboration across internal teams and external partners.
- Finally, you will drive innovation, standardization, and digitalization in mechanistic modeling and simulation by evaluating, developing, and implementing novel methodologies, tools, and technologies, while overseeing external modeling activities to ensure scientific excellence and strategic alignment.

Requirements

- PhD or equivalent advanced degree in systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, clinical pharmacology, computational biology, bioengineering, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
- Several years of hands-on professional experience in QSP modeling in the pharmaceutical industry, regulatory authorities, or relevant academic research
- In-depth knowledge of mechanistic modeling in clinical drug development, including model development, calibration, qualification, simulation, sensitivity analysis, and interpretation of results
- Experience with R and/or relevant QSP modeling platforms such as MATLAB/SimBiology, Julia, OSP Suite, or comparable tools; experience with statistical methods for analysis of nonclinical and clinical data is beneficial
- Strong ability to communicate complex modeling concepts, assumptions, uncertainties, and decision impact clearly to multidisciplinary audiences
- Proven collaboration skills in international, multidisciplinary teams and ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including experts, CROs, vendors, and leadership teams
- Fluent in written and spoken English

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our team  of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

Location/Division Specific Information

Fisher Clinical Services GmbH is a subsidiary of Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. and is a market leader in Clinical Supply Chain Management Services and Clinical Supplies for patients worldwide.
You can find out more about our location in Weil am Rhein and Rheinfelden here: www.fisherclinicalservices.com

Discover impactful Work

As a Quality Assurance Specialist (m/f/d) you will play an important role in supporting our Qualified Persons (QPs) throughout the certification and release process for clinical trial materials. Working in a highly regulated GMP/GDP environment, you will help ensure that all required documentation is complete, compliant and available for timely batch certification.

This role offers a unique combination of quality assurance, documentation management and cross-functional collaboration, allowing you to work closely with international customers, project teams and internal stakeholders while contributing directly to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

A Day in the Life

As part of our Quality Assurance team, you will help ensure that clinical trial materials are released accurately, compliantly and on schedule.

Your responsibilities include:

- Preparing, reviewing and compiling documentation required for QP certification and batch release
- Coordinating with customers, Global Project Managers and internal teams to obtain and track quality documentation
- Preparing Certificates of Release, Confirmations of Import and QP Declarations
- Verifying country-specific clinical trial approvals and maintaining release documentation
- Supporting the creation, review and maintenance of SOPs and other quality documents
- Maintaining QP tracking tools, documentation records and compliant archiving practices
- Supporting internal audits, client audits and health authority inspections
- Participating in investigations, CAPA activities and quality system improvements
- Contributing to Permanent Process Improvement (PPI) initiatives and helping optimize QA processes
- You'll work in close collaboration with cross-functional teams and play an important role in ensuring that clinical trial supplies meet the highest quality and regulatory standards before reaching patients around the world.

Keys to Success

Education:

- Completed vocational training as PTA, PKA, CTA, Pharmaceutical Assistant or a comparable qualification

Experience:

- Quality Assurance or Quality Control within the pharmaceutical industry
- Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment
- Previous exposure to documentation management, batch release or clinical supply operations is an advantage

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Good understanding of GMP/GDP requirements and pharmaceutical quality systems
- Structured, detail-oriented and quality-focused approach to work
- Strong organizational and documentation skills
- Customer-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with SharePoint, TrackWise or eDMS is beneficial
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams
- Fluent German and good English communication skills (written and spoken)

What we offer

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

Together with selected university partner sites, the German Cancer Research Center has established the German Cancer Consortium (https://dktk.dkfz.de/en) (Deutsches Konsortium für Translationale Krebsforschung, DKTK). The alliance between the DKFZ, as the core center, and the university partner sites in Berlin, Dresden, Essen/Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Mainz, Freiburg, Heidelberg, Munich, and Tübingen joins forces at eight joint translation centers. The DKTK promotes interdisciplinary preclinical translational research topics to accelerate the transfer of results into new approaches for prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of cancer and to develop strategies for personalized oncology. The consortium supports the training of the next generation of medical and clinician scientists, operates state-of-the-art, highly specialized research infrastructures and technical platforms, and promotes the transfer of innovations to the economy and society.

For the Research Group "Adaptive Glycan Remodeling in Cancer Progression" (https://amulyasreekumar.owlstown.net/)  (headed by Amulya Sreekumar) at the DKTK partner site Berlin, the DKFZ is seeking, starting in January 2027, a PhD Student in Cancer Biology.

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student to investigate the mechanisms driving breast cancer progression. Approximately 30% of breast cancer patients who are disease-free after initial therapy ultimately develop local or metastatic recurrences seeded by therapy-evasive residual tumor cells. Such cells often exist in a dormant state and subsequently exit dormancy, thus giving rise to recurrences. We are interested in the molecular mechanisms that promote residual tumor cell persistence after therapy and their subsequent reactivation.
Building on our recent discovery that tumor cell-autonomous glycan biosynthesis supports dormant cell persistence, this project aims to identify therapeutic strategies that disrupt glycan-mediated signaling to eliminate residual tumor cells and prevent lethal recurrence. The work will integrate mechanistic molecular biology, functional genomics, and advanced cancer models to achieve this goal.

The successful candidate will join the DKFZ International PhD Program (https://www.dkfz.de/en/career/international-phd-program) and work in a collaborative environment spanning DKFZ and Charité/DKTK Berlin. This partnership provides access to cutting-edge core facilities, including high-content imaging, flow cytometry, and genomics technologies at both institutions.
Our laboratory is located within the Department of Hematology, Oncology, and Cancer Immunology at Charité-Campus Virchow Klinikum in Berlin.

Your Tasks

- Performing molecular biology, cell biology, and biochemistry experiments using human and murine breast cancer models 
- Working with genetically engineered mouse models and transplantable tumors
- Gaining problem-solving and analytical skills through active participation and training
- Integration and interpretation of data 
- Presenting research findings at national/international conferences
- Contributing to high-impact scientific publications

Your Profile

- Master's degree in biology, biochemistry, or a related life sciences discipline 
- Strong interest in cancer research and the molecular mechanisms underlying disease progression
- Practical experience in molecular biology
- Mammalian cell culture experience and an interest in working with mouse models are desirable 
- Collaborative, highly motivated working style with good attention to detail
- Excellent written and spoken English

What makes this Position special:

- A fully funded PhD position within the DKFZ International PhD Program
- Close supervision and mentoring in an international research environment 
- Participate in collaborations with leading cancer research groups
- Hands-on experience using cutting-edge technologies, including CRISPR-based functional genomics, next-generation sequencing, imaging, and advanced disease models 
- Access to excellent core facilities at both DKFZ Heidelberg and Charité Berlin

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- Access to international research networks
- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

AI Governance, Trust & Compliance

- Define governance mechanisms that ensure traceability, auditability, explainability, observability, and accountability of agentic systems. - Embed responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and regulatory requirements into architectural patterns and operational controls. - Establish measurable governance gates and continuous, evidence-based assurance models for AI-assisted software delivery.

AI Platform & Toolchain Integration

- Drive integration of AI capabilities into developer toolchains, CI/CD platforms, engineering workflows, cloud environments, and enterprise systems. - Define reusable platform services supporting AI agents, evaluation pipelines, retrieval systems, model gateways, knowledge services, and policy enforcement.

Evaluation & Continuous Learning

- Define evaluation frameworks and quality metrics for AI-assisted development and autonomous agent execution. - Establish mechanisms for measuring business impact, engineering productivity, quality improvements, risk reduction, and AI adoption maturity. - Continuously assess emerging technologies and incorporate applicable innovations into the framework roadmap.

Materials Analysis is an Oxford Instruments Business Unit that manages our Electron Microscopy and Mechanical Microscopy products, Atomic Force Microscopes, Raman Microscopes and Benchtop NMR Products. We are part of the wider Oxford Instruments Group that also includes Andor Technology, NanoScience, Plasma Technology and X-Ray Technology. With a sixty-year history, and fourteen Queen’s Awards for Enterprise, our world-class products and technologies are helping our customers to address the greatest challenges of the 21st century.

The Role

We are looking for a Team Lead of Project Engineering to lead our Product Engineering function and act as a key interface between R&D, Production, Operations and the wider business. This is a hands?on leadership role combining product engineering, compliance and quality management, ensuring robust release processes and high?quality, compliant products.

You will be responsible for structuring and running the “back?end” of R&D: establishing processes, managing documentation, guiding the team, and ensuring smooth transitions from development to production.

This is a highly visible on?site role within a collaborative R&D and production environment.

Key Responsibilities Product Engineering Leadership
• Lead and develop the Product Engineering team
• Own and manage Product Engineering processes, including: Design freezes, Pilot series, Iterative improvement loops, Process freezes and volume gates
• Coordinate cross?functionally with R&D, Operations, Supply Chain and Product Management to support smooth product launches
• Clarify technical issues, prioritise tasks and resources, and ensure delivery against timelines and cost targets
• Ensure transparent communication on technical feasibility, risks, timelines and costs
• Own BOM management and continuous improvement
• Drive continuous product improvements after process freeze
• Identify and close process gaps between R&D and Operations
• Oversee realisation of SCS solutions, coordinating technical planning, construction and production
• Facilitate lessons?learned sessions after major SCS projects to determine future productisation
• Contribute to strategic initiatives such as: ERP and PLM development, Modularisation and variant management, Digitalisation of technical processes and workflows
• Manage Product Engineering?related change and improvement processes across multiple departments

Compliance
• Coordinate compliance activities for all new products through pilot series
• Manage compliance challenges and escalations (e.g. customer?specific requirements)
• Organise and maintain compliance documentation
• Support CE and EMC/EMV?related activities
• Coordinate contributions from other departments where required
• Act as the internal interface to compliance experts (expert knowledge remains with the central compliance team)
• Support release processes requiring external compliance sign?off

Quality Management
• Take overall responsibility for internal production quality standards
• Establish systems to track, analyse and evaluate test and measurement data
• Ensure quality processes support production rather than create additional burden (smart, pragmatic tooling and workflows)
• Coordinate and support production in case of quality issues
• Act as R&D’s interface to the ISO responsible person, supporting: Process mapping and version control, Identification and closure of R&D process gaps in line with ISO requirements
• Drive the completion of documentation gaps within Product Engineering and coordinate closure across R&D

What We’re Looking For
• Strong experience with high?tech products in a product or project engineering environment
• Proven people leadership and team coordination experience
• Highly organised, structured, and pragmatic problem?solver
• Strong understanding of quality, compliance, release and industrialisation processes
• Background or training in Six Sigma, quality management or similar methodologies
• Experience working towards or within ISO?compliant environments
• Ability to balance “what is required” with a focus on delivering a truly excellent product
• Confident communicator, comfortable operating at the interface between engineering and the wider organisation
• Strong project management skills
• Willingness to attend training and further develop expertise in ISO, compliance and quality

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
At Boehringer Ingelheim, we are committed to transforming the lives of patients suffering from severe pulmonary diseases. We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Postdoctoral Scientist to join our Vascular Health Cluster within Innovation & Research (I&R).
This position focuses on understanding the role of the pulmonary vasculature in chronic lung diseases, particularly pulmonary fibrosis (PF) and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). While epithelial injury has long been considered a key driver of disease progression, growing evidence highlights the pulmonary endothelium as a critical regulator of vascular remodeling, inflammation, tissue homeostasis, and fibrosis. Aberrant endothelial responses contribute to vascular dysfunction, increased permeability, altered angiogenesis, and pathological tissue remodeling.
As a postdoctoral researcher, you will drive the development of innovative in vivo models and advanced imaging approaches to investigate vascular remodeling and identify new opportunities for therapeutic intervention and drug triaging
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com
Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.
To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.
Tasks & responsibilities

- One of your key responsibilities will be to establish, characterize and validate novel in vivo models of pulmonary vascular pathologies, including aberrant angiogenesis, pathological vascular sprouting and endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT).
- You will investigate vascular remodeling in pulmonary fibrosis and COPD and define robust, disease-relevant endpoints for mechanistic and pharmacological studies.
- In regard to quantitative vascular assessment, you will develop readouts for aberrant angiogenesis, vascular thickening, pulmonary vascular volume and structural changes within the pulmonary vasculature.
- Moreover, you will apply and further develop high-resolution micro-computed tomography (µCT) of isolated lungs and image-based quantification pipelines for vascular analysis.
- In addition, you will identify and evaluate tissue-based and circulating biomarkers associated with pulmonary vascular pathology and translate preclinical findings into novel therapeutic concepts.
- Furthermore, you will collaborate with internal and external experts, present your findings at scientific meetings and contribute to mentoring students and junior scientists where appropriate.

Requirements

- PhD in Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacology, Veterinary Medicine, Imaging Sciences or a related discipline.
- FELASA-B certification or an equivalent qualification that enables independent work with laboratory animals, together with hands-on experience in animal models.
- Experience with µCT imaging and/or advanced image analysis methods; experience with computational imaging or independent programming will be an advantage.
- Solid knowledge of molecular and cellular biology techniques, including flow cytometry (FACS), Western blotting, ELISA, PCR/qPCR, and protein and RNA analysis.
- Knowledge of pulmonary diseases, particularly pulmonary fibrosis and/or COPD; expertise in vascular biology, endothelial cell biology, angiogenesis or fibrosis research will be an advantage.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in written and spoken English; German language skills will be a strong advantage.

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Structural Biology of Protein Kinase Regulation by RNA Helicases (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

How cells communicate with their environment via cell-cell interactions and by growth factors is a key question in the molecular life sciences, including tumor biology. Wnt signaling plays an important role in embryonic development and cancer.

In the Division of Molecular Embryology (headed by Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs), we study mechanisms of Wnt pathway regulation. To this end, we identify developmental control genes, investigate their biological role and biochemical mode of action, and examine how the genes are regulated.

To strengthen our team, we are seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Postdoc in Structural Biology of Protein Kinase Regulation by RNA Helicases.

Your Tasks

The Niehrs laboratory has identified DEAD-box RNA helicases as novel activators of protein kinases. In the context of Wnt-β-catenin signaling, DDX3 and CK1 cooperate and are both oncogenes. Understanding their regulatory interaction is therefore of considerable interest for the development of novel cancer therapeutics.

To unravel the mode of action whereby DDX3X activates CK1, you will solve and characterize the 3D structure of a DDX3-CK. To that end, you will produce recombinant DDX3X and CK1 proteins, purify and characterize their complexes using biochemical and biophysical methods. You will subject the kinase complexes to structural analysis using cryo-EM SPA or X-ray crystallography.

This project will be carried out in close collaboration between the laboratories of Prof. Dr. Irmgard Sinning at the University of Heidelberg and Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs at the DKFZ. The postdoc will primarily work in the lab of Prof. Sinning and will receive training in a broad range of state-of-the-art techniques in structural biochemistry and biophysics.  

Techniques employed include recombinant protein production, FPLC, Western blotting, automated protein crystallization, single-particle cryo-EM (SPA), advanced X-ray structure determination using synchrotron radiation, AI-assisted protein modeling, hydrogen–deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS), microscale thermophoresis (MST), and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC).

Your Profile

Applicants should hold a master's degree in molecular life sciences (e.g., biochemistry, biotechnology, molecular biology) with a background in recombinant protein work and/or structural biology. The applicant should be able to pursue research projects independently as well as in collaborations. Good written and oral command of English is essential.

Please submit a single PDF file including a CV (Germans: copies of Abitur & Masters degree), a cover letter stating your research and career interests, certificates, your expected availability date, and a list of publications, and attach two letters of reference.

Incomplete applications will not be considered or acknowledged.  

References:
Cruciat et al. (2013). RNA helicase DDX3 is a regulatory subunit of casein kinase 1 in Wnt-β-catenin signaling. Science 339, 1436-1441.

Fatti et al. (2023) DEAD-box RNA helicases act as nucleotide exchange factors for Casein Kinase 2. Science Signalling 16, eabp8923

Hirth et al. (2024) DEAD-box RNA helicases are pervasive protein kinase interactors and activators. Genome Res. 34, 952-966.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being
- Develop your full potential: access to the DKFZ International Postdoc Program and DKFZ Career Service with targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs
Phone: +49 (0)6221-42 4690

Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: September 9, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the EuroDrone Plateau, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) Digitalization Officer for Programme Management

You are a full-time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Project Manager (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us at the EuroDrone Plateau as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Ingolstadt
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration: 1 year with possible prolongation

You have a unique chance to participate, learn and grow in the full development cycle of European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS), aka Eurodrone.

The Eurodrone Program, which is led by Airbus as Prime Contractor in front of the customer (OCCAR: Organisation Conjointe de Coopération en matière d’Armement) and accounts several sub-contractors and suppliers across Europe, is organized in multi-disciplinary Delivery Teams (DTs) ensuring a cross-national, cross-company multi-functional integration and delivery of sub-products. In the specific case of this position, the focus will be primarily on the core business of the MAGiCS Team e.g. the operational components of Eurodrone: Mission, Armament, Ground Control Station, Human Machine Interface and Human Factors Engineering. Efficiency of the development cycle is supported by a plateau located in Ingolstadt (Manching site) where all key actors are cooperating under one roof.

We are seeking a highly motivated working student to join our team of DT MAGiCS as a Digitalization Officer for Programme Management. As the Digitalization Officer for Programme Management, you will be responsible for digitalizing the project management environment using Jira, Confluence and Sharepoint. This includes setting up workflows,creating and assigning tasks, tracking progress, and mastering the challenge of artificial intelligence within Jira. You will work closely with the project manager and the rest of the project team to ensure that the project is delivered on time, on cost, and on quality.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Job Description

About Us

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Our global Clinical Operations teams provide end-to-end clinical trial support — from study start-up through close-out — across commercial and government-sponsored studies.

Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific / PPD?

- Work on high-quality, global clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas
- Be part of a stable, well-established organization with long-term career opportunities
- Strong collaboration with experienced CTMs and project teams
- Clear development pathways (e.g., Senior CRA, Lead CRA, CTM)
- Flexible working models that support work-life balance
- Permanent employment
- Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (32 hours/week) options available

About the Role

This position is for experienced Clinical Research Associates with 2+ years of independent monitoring experience. You will manage clinical trial sites across Germany, ensuring studies are conducted in compliance with the protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, and company SOPs.

You’ll work autonomously, partner closely with investigative sites, and collaborate with project teams to deliver high-quality, inspection-ready clinical trials.

What You’ll Do

- Perform site monitoring activities (on-site and remote) using a risk-based monitoring approach
- Ensure protocol, ICH-GCP, regulatory, and SOP compliance at investigator sites
- Conduct SDR, SDV, CRF review, and investigational product accountability
- Identify, document, escalate, and follow up on issues through resolution, applying root cause analysis and CAPA principles
- Maintain audit and inspection readiness at all assigned sites
- Build strong, collaborative relationships with investigators and site staff
- Document monitoring activities in timely, high-quality reports and follow-up letters
- Maintain ongoing communication with sites between visits to support issue resolution and data quality
- Ensure study systems (e.g., CTMS) are updated according to study conventions
- Provide trial status updates and metrics to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM)
- Support study start-up, investigator identification, site initiation, and study close-out activities as assigned
- Participate in investigator meetings, audits, inspections, and project team meetings as required

Additional responsibilities may include supporting process improvement initiatives, mentoring activities, or project-specific tasks aligned with experience.

A Day in the Life

- Review site metrics and prioritize monitoring activities based on risk
- Conduct on-site or remote monitoring visits
- Partner with sites to resolve findings and improve processes
- Collaborate with CTMs and project teams to keep studies on track and inspection-ready
- Complete documentation, system updates, and administrative tasks

Education & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent qualification
- Minimum 2+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate / Monitor
- Valid driver’s license
- Full right to work in Germany
- Fluency in German and English (C1 level) – interviews will be conducted in German

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong clinical monitoring skills with hands-on RBM experience
- Excellent understanding and application of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations
- Solid therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Well-developed critical thinking, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with medical professionals
- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to cross-functional teams
- Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic project environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn clinical systems (e.g., CTMS)

Locations: Home-based or hybrid anywhere in Germany
FTE: Full-time (40 hrs/week) or Part-time 80% (32 hrs/week)
Contract: Permanent
Travel: Approximately 50–75% (study-dependent)

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
We are seeking an accomplished Scientist to advance our mission of delivering disease-modifying therapies to patients with liver cirrhosis.
As Principal Scientist, you will lead a team of lab scientists and take ownership of identifying and advancing novel therapeutic approaches — from target identification through to candidate selection. A deep understanding of liver physiology and expert knowledge of disease-relevant cellular and tissue models will set you up for success in this role.
Join us and drive innovative drug discovery projects within our Cardio-Renal-Metabolic Diseases Research Department, located at Boehringer Ingelheim's largest R&D site in Biberach an der Riss, Germany. You will work alongside talented colleagues, access cutting-edge technology, and help shape the future of liver disease therapy
Tasks & responsibilities

- Manage an in vitro pharmacology lab and mentor a team of highly skilled lab scientists, fostering a collaborative environment and actively developing the skills of your team members.

Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools, outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. The company maintains a global manufacturing and product development footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2 billion and around 50,000 employees

SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speedEurope's industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.
A factory that ships in days rather than months is only as fast as what moves in and out of it. Our materials, equipment, and parts cross borders — between European countries, and out to customers in defense, aerospace, and space. Every tariff classification, every export declaration, every forwarder who doesn't deliver is a potential standstill at the end of the line.
Until now, this has been handled across several people. From here on, it belongs to one.
The Roleou are the first person at SAEKI to own import and export end to end. Early on, that means doing it yourself: you run the day-to-day execution, clean up where processes are improvised, and build the structure underneath as you go — customs procedures, export control, service provider landscape, ERP data.
We're growing fast, and this function grows with us. One person becomes a team. Whoever takes this role now decides what logistics at SAEKI looks like in three years — which providers we use, which processes run, which systems we're on, and who operates them. That isn't a promise of a title; it's a realistic path: build the function well, and you lead it.
Based in the greater Munich area, on-site at Factory ONE.

Your Responsibilities
• Import & export execution: You handle national and international shipments end to end — including shipping and customs documentation, tariff classification, and proofs of origin.
• Cross-border movements: You own transport between our Swiss and German sites, as well as to customers and suppliers across Europe and beyond.
• Export control: You build how we assess and document dual-use and export-controlled matters — not an optional topic in our markets.
• Provider management: You select forwarders and logistics service providers, negotiate terms, and keep performance and cost transparent.
• Process building: You turn recurring activities into documented processes — written so they hold up when someone other than you runs them.
• ERP & data: You keep logistics data in the ERP clean, current, and usable, and help shape how the system is set up for logistics.
• Interface role: You work closely with procurement, production, and engineering, and you're the point where delivery dates become commitments.
• Scaling: You recognise when the work outgrows one person, and build the next stage with us — processes, tools, team.

What We're Looking For
• Foundation: A completed commercial apprenticeship or degree in logistics, supply chain management, international trade, or a comparable field.
• Experience: 2–5 years in import, export, or international logistics, with solid hands-on practice in customs and export handling.
• Independence: You're comfortable arriving without an existing department, a predecessor, or a finished playbook — and you see that as an advantage.
• Appetite for building: You don't just want to process shipments, you want to shape the function. You think about how something works at ten times the volume while you're doing it for the first time.
• Systems mindset: Confident with ERP systems, and inclined to build processes into the system rather than into isolated spreadsheets.
• Reliability: Commitments hold. When something slips, the team hears it early — not on the delivery date.
• Language: Fluent German, good English.
• Location: On-site in the greater Munich area.

What we're not looking for
• Administrators . If you're looking for a settled department with clear boundaries, this isn't it — that department doesn't exist yet, and building it is the job.
• People who want to lead without having done the operational work themselves. The first months are hands-on.
• Pragmatism without precision. Customs and export control don't forgive shortcuts.

What we offer
• Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West — in an environment where logistics isn't a support function but a precondition.
• Ownership of a function: From day one you own a function, not a task list. Your decisions stand.
• Growth path: The function grows with the company. Whoever builds it has the first claim on leading it.
• Short paths: Direct line to management, production, and engineering. "Special Forces" model — everyone ships, no politics, no bureaucracy.
• The environment: State-of-the-art manufacturing technology, a data-driven production environment, a site under construction.
• Compensation: Competitive salary incl. share options.
• Location: Factory ONE, greater Munich area.

Apply

• Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? And: what's the most complicated customs or export case you've personally resolved?

Job description

In order to support our “Technical Certification Team”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Electronics and/or military Avionics Designated Airworthiness Engineer (d/f/m)

This team provides certification expertise across all Airbus Defence and Space aircraft programs and represents Airbus Defence and Space in rulemaking and international industrial standardisation working groups.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead the certification, qualification and Continued Airworthiness activities for the Electronics and/or Military Avionics technical disciplines.
- Provide airworthiness approvals and exercise Design Organisations Approvals (DOA) as well as Military Design Organisation Approvals (MDOA) privileges for the scope of assigned responsibility as delegated by the Office of Chief of Airworthiness.
- Be responsible for the timely achievement of certification and qualification milestones through identification of major program technical issues and associated risk management plan, identification of regulation and interpretation issues and identification of safety and certification compliance issues.
- Lead the necessary activities for the investigation of incidents and accidents for those aspects regarding Airworthiness technical knowledge.
- Provide technical certification knowledge in Electronics and/or Military Avionics to the design organization, or special projects.
- Influence the definition of certification policies for the technical discipline under his/her scope, and promote their consistent application across programs, including the participation in the development of new and foreseen technical certification strategies or policies. In particular for novel or unusual design features or for compliance demonstration method improvement.
- Represent Airbus Defence and Space in rulemaking and international industrial standardisation working groups for technical certification.
- Contribute to technical certification de-risking in Airbus Defence and Space Research and Technology (R&T) as well as Research and Development (R&D) projects related to the Airworthiness Technical.
- Gather and disseminate Technical Certification regulatory knowledge and expertise within Airbus Defence and Space, particularly for Compliance Verification Engineers (CVE) and Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE) community, to maintain state of the art.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace Engineering.
- Extensive professional experience (more than 10 years) in Airworthiness functions related to Electronics and/or Military Avionics discipline.
- Experience interfacing with Aviation Authorities is a plus.
- Excellent negotiation skills, strong interpersonal and consulting skills.
- Ability to understand complex issues and break them down in order to develop solutions independently.
- Advanced level of English.
- Good knowledge of German language is a plus.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?

Not through marketing spin. Not through vague purpose-driven messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.

Thats what Tanso is building. And its one of the reasons people join us.

Why Tanso?

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for an experienced Masses, Loadsand Vibration Engineer to join our young and growing flight physics team. In this role, you will act as the interface between the flight physics andstructure teams: you will provide the mass estimations, derive the critical load cases from all relevant flight conditions, and quantify and mitigate vibrations for an unmanned, hybrid-electric VTOL transition aircraft. You will be responsible for the mass model, the design load envelopes and the vibration environment from early design through test verification, and your results directly shape structural sizing, performance predictions and the certification evidence of our aircraft. Working close to the hardware is part of the job - ground vibration tests, load testing and flight test verification rely on your hands-on involvement from planning through evaluation.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Develop and maintain a mass modelfor all aircraft parts and equipment, including derivation of the weight & balance envelope
• Define, verify and document design load envelopes (flight, ground, gust, maneuvers, landing and payload),traceable to certification bases
• Release critical load cases to a configuration-controlled database that serves as input to the structure team
• Quantify vibration sources and their propagation through structural parts, and design and test mitigation means
• Analyze and demonstrate aeroelastic stability (flutter, whirl flutter, divergence) across the envelope
• Maintain structural elastic models(stiffness and modal representations) and provide them to simulation and control design
• Plan, conduct and evaluate verification campaigns: interface load testing, ground vibration tests and flight test points

WHAT YOU BRING
• You hold an academic degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical course of study
• Five or more years of professional experience in loads analysis, structural dynamics or mass properties in aerospace round out your background
• Working with loads and dynamics toolchains, preferably Python, is something you're comfortable with
• A sound understanding of loads and vibration requirements in a certification context is part of your expertise
• Target-oriented self-management comes naturally to you, along with the ability to work both within a team and autonomously.
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical writing skills complete your profile.
• Fluent English rounds out your qualifications

The following would further strengthen your application:
• Rotorcraft or eVTOL experience, particularly with rotor-induced vibration, is a plus
• Hands-on involvement in ground vibration testing or flight test campaigns adds to your profile
• Experience with aeroelastic stability analysis, such as flutter or whirl flutter, is a valuable asset
• Familiarity with FE-based structural dynamics tools, such as Nastran, strengthens your application
• Mass properties management according to industry practice is an area you bring experience in

• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides

• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution

**3D Imaging Specialist – Collection Digitisation (m/f/d) **

Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following two positions in the Department of Palaeontology & Historical Geology and the Department of Messel Research and Paleobiology at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as of 01 January 2027

3D Imaging Specialist – Collection Digitisation (m/f/d)

(full time / part time)

Location: Frankfurt (Hesse)

Organizational units:

Department of Palaeontology & Historlcal Geology, Section Amber Research

Department of Messel Research and Paleobiology, Section Palaeomammalogy

Department of Palaeoanthropology, Section Mammalogy

Employment scope: Full-time / Part-time

Type of contract: Project-based, fixed-term for three years

Remuneration: Collective agreement of Hesse, TV-H E 9

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.

Within the framework of the project "SCRE3NED: Senckenberg Collection's RarEst – 3-dimensioNal Enhanced Digitisation", type specimens of exceptional scientific value (holotypes, paratypes and lectotypes) from various collections of the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt (amber, extant and fossil mammals, Messel fossils) are digitised using micro-computed tomography (μCT), synchrotron radiation-based micro-computed tomography (SRμCT), and digital photography. The aim is to produce high-quality, standardised and FAIR-compliant 2D and 3D datasets for research, collection management and science communication.

Your tasks

- Performing and documenting μCT scans in accordance with established quality standards
- Supporting the preparation and execution of SRμCT scanning campaigns at external research facilities
- Reconstruction, segmentation and quality control of 3D image datasets
- Contributing to the implementation of photography-based digitisation methods
- Creation, maintenance and management of metadata in accordance with the FAIR principles
- Preparation and integration of digital datasets into the collection databases (DINA, SeSam/AQUiLA)
- Further development, optimisation and standardisation of workflows for the 3D digitisation of a range of different object groups
- Ensuring consistent data and file organisation as well as long-term archiving
- Collaboration with curators, scientists, IT specialists and external project partners

Your profile

- Completed vocational training in a technical or scientific field (e.g., technical assistant for natural history museums and research institutes, biological or medical laboratory technician, photographic technical assistant, preparator) or a completed university degree (Bachelor's/Master's) in biology, earth sciences, medical engineering, computer science, engineering, media technology or a related field, or a comparable qualification with relevant professional experience

- Confident use of software for 3D image processing and segmentation (e.g., Avizo/Amira, VGStudio MAX, Dragonfly, 3D Slicer).
- Good IT skills and a willingness to familiarise yourself with new software environments
- Knowledge of digital data management and data organisation
- Careful and responsible handling of unique and sometimes fragile objects
- Valid category B driving licence
- A structured, independent and solution-oriented approach to work, combined with the ability to work well in a team
- Good written and spoken German and English

Desirable skills

- Experience in operating and working with computed tomography systems
- Knowledge of 3D printing techniques and of preparing models for printing
- Experience with photography-based digitisation methods, in particular photogrammetry
- Familiarity with the FAIR principles and experience with repositories for 3D data (e.g., MorphoSource) or with collection databases
- Interest in natural history collections, biodiversity research and digitisation
- Basic knowledge of vertebrate and insect morphology

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our career page (https://www.senckenberg.de/en/stellenanzeigen/ ) and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.

As an Expert Business Partner (f/m/d), you will be a key finance business partner within the TI Compression Business Controlling team. You will take a leading role in orchestrating forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and preliminary actuals across the organization. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior management, you will ensure financial transparency, challenge business performance, and provide actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the consolidation, validation, and submission of forecasts while steering monthly reporting, preliminary actuals, and quarterly closing activities
* Lead and coordinate annual budgeting and long-term financial planning processes across multiple entities and stakeholders
* Own the analysis of actuals, forecasts, budgets, and prior-period results, identifying key business drivers, variances, risks, and opportunities
* Challenge and translate financial results into actionable business insights and develop compelling narrative reporting for senior management
* Act as a strategic finance partner to Controllers, Business Departments, Functional Stakeholders, and CP Management, including interaction with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Drive global continuous improvements across planning, reporting, data quality, and forecasting accuracy while leading cross-functional and international initiatives

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field
* Significant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Business Controlling, or Corporate Finance, ideally gained in medium-sized to large international organizations; M&A experience is a plus
* Strong international and cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to lead and influence stakeholders across functions, entities, and cultures
* Strong understanding of financial statements, business drivers, and performance metrics, ideally gained in a manufacturing, industrial, or project-driven environment
* Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills, with proven experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders up to C-level
* Professional proficiency in English, both written and verbal

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing 
electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We 
enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, 
building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and 
integrated execution capabilities

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Business Controller (f/m/d) within the TI CP Business Controlling team, you serve as a trusted advisor to the Compression Service Region Europe & Africa, supporting a business spanning more than 35 countries. Working closely with regional leadership, finance teams, and operational stakeholders, you provide transparency on financial performance, drive forecasting and budgeting processes, and enable data-driven decision-making across a dynamic and diverse business environment.

Beyond core business controlling, you contribute to key strategic initiatives, including Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), sustainability reporting, central function controlling, and high-impact transformation projects. By combining financial expertise with business acumen and cross-functional collaboration, you help drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation across the region.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Acting as the primary Finance Business Partner for the Compression Service Europe & Africa management team, providing financial transparency and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
* Leading regional forecasting, budgeting, financial performance reviews, and financial planning & analysis activities across a network of more than 35 countries while identifying risks and opportunities
* Strengthening the Enterprise Risk Management framework and partnering with sustainability teams to support ESG initiatives, including EU Taxonomy reporting and compliance requirements
* Providing financial governance and controlling support for central functions, ensuring cost transparency, effective resource allocation, and sound financial governance
* Leading and supporting strategic projects and transformation initiatives, delivering financial insights, business case analyses, and value-creating recommendations
* Promoting process harmonization, digitalization, and automation to improve reporting quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making capabilities

What You Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or other advanced degree is considered an advantage
* Proven experience in controlling, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business partnering, or finance leadership within an international environment
* Strong expertise in forecasting, budgeting, financial reporting, variance analysis, performance management, and financial governance, ideally complemented by knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management, ESG, or sustainability reporting
* Proven analytical and strategic capabilities with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations and influence management decisions
* Hands-on experience with SAP, financial planning systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office, combined with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills in multicultural organizations
* Fluent English skills; additional language skills are considered an advantage 

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
...you're in the middle of it

Our **Department of Nephrology **and the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center (EKFZ) provide excellent, state-of-the-art facilities to conduct interdisciplinary and computational research at the intersection of nephrology, immunology, and cardiovascular biology. We offer an attractive, supportive environment for modern science in molecular medicine and systems biology. We are looking for an ambitious, talented and highly motivated candidate to join our team.

The project that you are working on is embedded in a translational research program aiming to understand how the hematopoietic system crosslinks interactions between aging, cardiovascular, and kidney diseases. You will integrate multi-omic datasets to investigate molecular and cellular mechanisms in various organs and immune cells. By bridging single-cell resolution with global biobank scales, your work will help identify novel molecular mechanisms and therapeutic targets.

The candidate will be supervised and supported by experienced computational biologists, molecular biologists and clinicians. The project is designed to perform cutting-edge research with state-of-the-art methods and technologies.

Your Role:

- Analyze and integrate in-house and publicly available single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq, and CITE-seq datasets
- Analyze large-scale genomic, proteomic and clinical data from the UK Biobank (UKB) and All of Us Research Program
- Develop and implement reproducible and scalable computational pipelines and workflows
- Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and clinicians in an interdisciplinary environment to define hypotheses and interpret results in a biological and clinical context
- Present research findings within the working group and at international conferences and publish in peer-reviewed journals and cumulate your findings in a doctoral thesis

... your skills are what we're looking for

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in computational or molecular biology, bioinformatics, molecular medicine or a related field
- Proficiency in either R or Python for data analysis, statistics, and visualization.
- Previous experience with bioinformatic analysis of single-cell RNAseq analysis (Seurat/Scanpy) and/or genetic data
- A solid foundational understanding of molecular biology, genetics, or immunology, and a keen interest in human disease mechanisms.
- Keen interest in leveraging omics to elucidate disease mechanisms in cardiovascular and/or kidney disease and immunology
- Previous experience with reproducible coding practices and working in cloud environments is a plus.
- Solid understanding of statistics
- Willingness to understand and apply state-of-the-art computational tools and algorithms for single-cell, multi-omics and genetic analysis
- Very good verbal and written skills in English; German is an advantage but not required
- High motivation, ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary team, excellent organizational and communication skills
- Due to legal regulations, valid proof of measles immunity / measles vaccination is required.

jobs.occupation: Research Software Engineer (all genders) HPC Code Performance Optimisation (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
The German Climate Computing Centre (DKRZ) is the central simulation and data processing facility for the German climate and Earth system modelling community and one of the leading institutions in this field worldwide. DKRZ not only operates supercomputers of the highest performance class and one of the largest data and archive systems, but also participates in many national and international projects aimed at improving the software and infrastructure for climate modelling. Here we are offering a position as

Research Software Engineer (all genders)

HPC Code Performance Optimisation

Your tasks

DKRZ plays a significant role in a number of projects with the aim of advancing Earth System Modelling (ESM). This facilitates the advancement of scientific knowledge in the fields of Earth system modelling and climate research. In the context of the current development of digital twins of the Earth, it is necessary to adapt increasingly complex models and corresponding software to the most powerful HPC systems in Europe and ensure that those codes run stable and efficiently.

As a member of the team of Research Software Engineers (RSEs), you will collaborate with Earth System scientists to overcome technical challenges in high-performance computing (HPC) and software development. Your responsibilities will include further developing, testing and optimising existing coupled Earth System models. This will allow them to be extended with new components (e.g. ice sheet models) without compromising the efficient execution time. This is a key challenge, given the need to use resources effectively on current and future HPC systems. For this position, we are looking for candidates who are interested in the interdisciplinary implementation of Earth System models and who want to apply their programming skills to new challenges.

Qualifications / Experiences

•Academic degree in computer science, applied mathematics, computational physics/engineering or related fields with a focus on scientific computing

•Strong interest in and experience with HPC-systems and parallel programming with MPI/OpenMP

•Knowledge of programming with C/C++ and/or Fortran under UNIX/LINUX and scripting languages

•Experience in the use and programming of GPU systems for scientific applications is an advantage

•Experience in algorithms, data structures and design of scientific software is welcome

•Very good communication skills and knowledge of English

Employment conditions

We offer opportunities to work in interdisciplinary teams and have excellent connections to national and international research networks. In addition to specific implementation and support requirements from our users and project partners, your work will be characterised by the freedom to work creatively at the interface between applied computer science and the development of scientific applications. Attendance at international conferences, project meetings and hackathons facilitate further training and the presentation of your own results.

Our company is headquartered in Hamburg, but we are committed to creating a flexible working environment. We offer a remote working option, with the possibility of working from home up to 100% within Germany. Remuneration will be based on the candidate's qualifications according to TVöD-Bund. The ideal commencement date would be September 2026, although this is flexible and can be discussed on an individual basis. The position is funded by a third-party project, with a limited initial timeframe until the end of 2028.

Interested applicants are requested to compile a single pdf document containing a cover letter, a detailed CV and any additional documents (e.g. professional references). Applications must be submitted via the portalhttps://dkrz.softgarden.io/en/vacancies

Application deadline: Open until filled. Priority will be given to applications received by 23 August 2026

Questions? Dr. Hendryk Bockelmann (bockelmann@dkrz.de) will be happy to answer them in advance.
